verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cerebras has a public catalog of open-source models ([cerebras-docs-21], [cerebras-docs-18]) and currently hosts a recent model, qwen-3.8-27b ([cerebras-docs-29], [cerebras-comm-1]). Nothing documents or reports how soon newly released open-weight models arrive after their public release, such as day-zero launches, a release cadence, or turnaround times. Because time-to-availability is the core of this story and is unevidenced, it earns no credit.
